justification: Simple numeric comparison function with no memory operations or attacker-influenced memory access patterns.
analysis: This function takes four parameters: two minimum/maximum port values and a port to check against, all of which are unsigned 16-bit integers. The function performs a simple comparison operation without any memory operations, allocations, or pointer dereferences. All inputs are numeric values that could potentially come from user-supplied data in netfilter rules, but the function only does basic arithmetic comparisons with no risk of buffer overflows, use-after-free, or other memory safety issues.
